name: The Maker

abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Special Power Drain: Etkilenen şampiyon özel saldırı kullandığında, kalan gücünün belirtilen yüzdesi pasif olarak çekilir.
abilityDetails.Instants Siphon: Gelen anlık hasar etkilerinin gücünü artırır, giden anlık hasar etkilerinin gücünü azaltır.
abilityDetails.Cowardice: Özel saldırı hasarını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Counter-Attack Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Reroute: Aktifken, rakibin güç kazanım oranı düştüğü ölçüde bu şampiyonun güç kazanım oranı artar.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Dövüşe kaçış yüküyle başlar — ağır saldırıyla kaldır. E1'de plazma mayını aktive eder (mayına değmek anlık enerji hasarı verir, uzak dur). Kaçtığında pasif sersemletir. Enerji dirençli şampiyonlar mayından daha az etkilenir.
signatureAbility:
Contingency Plans
When The Maker's Tactical Evasion Stun fails to be inflicted or is removed before its duration expires, inflict a non-stacking [236.88 - 685.8] Energy Vulnerability Passive and gain Stun Immunity for 4 seconds.
The Maker starts each fight with 1 Special Evade Charge that is consumed to Evade a hit during a Special Attack. This does not trigger during a Well-Timed Block. Gain 1 extra Charge for every 60 signature levels.
Remove all Special Evade Charges when struck by a Heavy Attack.
Gain a Special Evade Charge when the Plasma Mine is triggered during The Maker's Special Attacks.
immunityDetails:
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı 🧠
• Nörşok Bağışıklığı ⚡️🧠

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: The Maker has altered his being and developed an Immunity to Neuroshock and Reversed Controls.
The Maker hates luck. He cannot land Critical Hits, and all personal effects and the Stun from the Parry Mastery have 125% Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: Planning Charges - Max: 8
content: The Maker starts each Quest with 4 Persistent Planning Charges.

In the Pre-Fight Menu, choose up to 3 Planned Obsolescence Passives to inflict on the Opponent at the start of the fight. Each Passive costs 1 Planning Charge and is inflicted even if a different Champion enters the fight.
The Maker's teammates help progress his plans. For each fight he or a teammate wins, he gains 1 Planning Charge the next time he enters a fight.

abilitySections.title: Planned Obsolescence - Pre-Fight Passives - Max: 1 Each
content: All Planned Obsolescence Passives have a 15 second duration and are refreshed when the Opponent is knocked down.
Inflict a 45% Special Power Drain Passive.
Inflict a 14% Instants Siphon Passive.
Inflict a 20% Cowardice Passive.
Planned Obsolescence potency is halved unless the Attacker is a Tech Champion or is one of The Maker's outgoing synergy partners.
Planned Obsolescence potency scales with the rarity of The Maker. If different versions of a Passive are applied, only the strongest one triggers.

abilitySections.title: Tactical Evasion
content: When The Maker would perform a Well-Timed Block against a Basic Attack, he Evades the attack instead.
When The Maker Evades a Basic Attack, inflict a Stun Passive for 3 seconds. This Stun is removed when the Opponent is struck twice.
When this Stun would be inflicted, the Stun and this Evade go on a shared cooldown for 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack
content: Heavy Attacks do not add to The Maker's Combo Meter.
The final hit pauses The Maker's Planned Obsolescence Passives for 5 seconds, and inflicts a Heal Block Debuff for 8 seconds.
The final hit inflicts an Instant Plasma dealing [4,927.5] Energy Damage multiplied by The Maker's Critical Damage Multiplier.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - What's Yours is Mine
content: Deploy a Plasma Mine in front of The Maker.

abilitySections.title: Plasma Mine - Max: 1
content: If the Opponent moves onto the Plasma Mine, it triggers, inflicting an Instant Plasma dealing [12,045] Energy Damage multiplied by The Maker's Critical Damage Multiplier. As a Defender, deal 1% of this damage.
The Plasma Mine needs to recharge after triggering. The Plasma Mine recharges while The Maker is charging his Heavy Attack and by a small amount when either Champion is struck.
Triggering the Plasma Mine inflicts a 10% Suppression Passive on the Opponent for 30 seconds. Max stacks: 6.
While suffering from one of The Maker's Suppressions, they are also inflicted with a 75% potency Power Reroute Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Elastic Gatling
content: On activation, remove the recharge on the Plasma Mine.

If the Opponent is not Blocking, triggering the Plasma Mine during this attack overcharges it, increasing its base potency by 200%, plus an additional 40% for each personal Suppression on the Opponent. Overcharging the Mine destroys it.
Gain 1 Planning Charge when triggering an overcharged Mine, plus 1 extra for every 3 personal Suppressions on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Flexible Schemes
content: Re-trigger The Maker's selected Pre-Fight Planned Obsolescence Passives.
At the end of this attack, The Maker moves an existing Plasma Mine behind his Opponent and empowers it for 12 seconds. The empowered Plasma Mine automatically recharges every 0.5 seconds.
